title: block_cache eviction_removes_lru_entry flaky
description: The test inserts cid1 and cid2 in rapid succession; both can get the same SQLite last_access timestamp, making LRU ordering non-deterministic. cid1 or cid2 may be evicted. Fix: add a small sleep between puts, or use a monotonic sequence counter for last_access instead of wall-clock milliseconds.
